sloka: सुतीक्ष्णस्य आश्रमम् श्रीमान् पुनर् एव आजगाम ह ।स तम् आश्रमम् आगम्य मुनिभिः परिपूजितः ॥३-११-२८॥
transliteration: sutīkṣṇasya āśramam śrīmān punar eva ājagāma ha ।sa tam āśramam āgamya munibhiḥ paripūjitaḥ ॥3-11-28॥

translations.english: Rama went round who was full of grace and full of knowledge on dharma went round with Sita and came back to Suthikshna's hermitage.
